forms.stoppedAt: Travel information: the stepper will not advance without a flight, arrival date and length of stay; later steps are not reachable by URL (single-page form)

steps.name: Travel information

fields.label: Countries visited in the last six months

notices: Travellers are required, under Mauritian law, to complete the Health Declaration Form before travelling to Mauritius. Proof of completion of the form will be required at boarding. Refusal to complete the form, or knowingly providing false information, may result in a fine of up to MUR 500,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years.

The Health Declaration Form is completely free of charge and the Government of Mauritius does not charge any fee for this form. Data collected for the purpose of immigration and health surveillance complies with our Data Protection Act.
All fields marked with an asterix(*) are required

forms.title: Mauritius Premium Visa — National E-Licensing (EDB) application
forms.stoppedAt: The 'Apply for Premium Visa' link opens the Premium Visa page of the National E-Licensing portal (business.edbmauritius.org), where the application starts only after REGISTER / LOGIN

steps.name: Premium Visa information (EDB)
notices: To qualify for the Premium Visa, interested visitors should produce proof of their long stay plans and sufficient travel and health insurance for the initial period of stay while meeting the following criteria: the applicants should not enter the Mauritius Labour market; the main place of business and source of income and profits should be outside Mauritius; documentary evidence to support application such as purpose of visit, accommodation etc.; and other basic immigration requirements.
It allows a non-citizen to stay in Mauritius for a period exceeding six (6) months up to one (1) year with an option to renew.
